name: Linguist
description:
You have studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits:
- You learn three languages of your choice.
- You have an elementary understanding of all spoken languages. You may engage in basic communication with a creature that can understand at least one language but shares none with you. You and the DM decide how this communication occurs; an example could be only communicating in one-syllable words.
- You can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code you create unless you teach them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC equal to your 10 + your Intelligence modifier + your proficiency bonus), or they use magic to decipher it.
snippet: You learn three languages of your choice and have an elementary understanding of all spoken languages.
